subject.title: OAuth 401 regression: oauth-2025-04-20 beta not injected when context1m set via model headers

question: Should maintainers adopt or retarget the open fork PR, or ignore it and sponsor a narrow same-repository fix in the active Anthropic transport header-composition path?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the open closing PR is in a fork, stale, and aimed at older files while same-repository attempts were closed unmerged, so automation should not start a competing fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a current-main fix
options.body: Land a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level `anthropic-beta` headers.

options.title: Adopt and retarget the fork PR
options.body: Ask a maintainer to bring the fork change into the main repository, update it for current transport code, and require focused proof before merge.

options.title: Pause behind the fork candidate
options.body: Leave this issue open without a new repair lane until the fork author or a maintainer updates the closing PR into a viable landing path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a current-main fix
recommendation.body: Land a focused same-repository patch in the active Anthropic transport path with regression tests for direct OAuth plus model-level `anthropic-beta` headers.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision centers on the active Anthropic provider/header boundary, where vincentkoc has the strongest current-main history signal.
